capture_route.evidence: https://infisical.com/docs/self-hosting/deployment-options/docker-compose (linked from github.com-Infisical/infisical/README.md:98); docker-compose.prod.yml maps 80:8080 (github.com-Infisical/infisical/docker-compose.prod.yml:15-16)
capture_route.gotcha: The .env.example ships sample ENCRYPTION_KEY and AUTH_SECRET values with an explicit 'SHOULD NEVER BE USED FOR PRODUCTION' comment (github.com-Infisical/infisical/.env.example:4,8-9) - fine for a screenshot box, must be regenerated for anything real. SITE_URL in .env.example is http://localhost:8080 while the prod compose publishes on :80 - fix SITE_URL or email/redirect links break. Postgres + Redis + backend, 3-4 containers.
